If tonight is the emergency

Do not wait on us. If someone is in immediate danger, call 911. For free, confidential help at any hour, call or text 988. For treatment referrals near you, SAMHSA's national helpline is 1-800-662-4357. Then call us in the morning.

911Immediate danger
988Suicide & crisis lifeline
1-800-662-4357SAMHSA treatment referrals
